t: Bosch Expert Multi-Wheel cutting disc with sharp carbide grits on the rim for effective cutting in multiple materials. Suitable for use with angle grinders, the carbide grits are laser-bonded to a steel body for strength and durability. The carbide cutting disc is designed to cut wood, embedded screws and nails, plastic pipes, and to make accurate cutouts in panels such as laminates and drywall. Maintains a constant speed and depth with steel body and Carbide Technology. 115 x 22.23mm.
b: For Chipboard, MDF, Plastic, Wood & Wood with Nails
